articles.title: OpenAI weighs 5% stake for US government amid Trump talks: FT
articles.snippet: OpenAI has reportedly discussed giving the US government a 5% equity stake in early Trump administration talks as Washington tightens AI model oversight.

articles.title: Trumps’ American Bitcoin sinks 8.4% ahead of reverse stock split to stay listed
articles.snippet: The Trump sons' American Bitcoin hit a low on Wednesday ahead of the company’s reverse stock split, which aims to buoy shares and keep it on the Nasdaq.

articles.title: Trump-Backed American Bitcoin Hits New Low Price Ahead of Reverse Stock Split
articles.snippet: Bitcoin mining firm American Bitcoin fell to a new low price Wednesday, one day before executing a 1-for-15 reverse stock split.

articles.title: Anthropic Bringing Claude Fable 5 Back Online as US Lifts Export Controls
articles.snippet: The Trump administration reversed its shutdown order after weeks of talks, with Anthropic tying Fable 5's return to a new safety classifier and other moves.

articles.title: Trump Discloses Over $1.2 Billion in Crypto Earnings, $50M in Bitcoin Holdings
articles.snippet: The president’s annual financial disclosure report was released on Tuesday.
